title: Zook
tagline: A Uniswap V4 Hook that Deposits into the best pool in the network using oracles
description:
The project leverages Uniswap V4 Hooks + Chainlink to allow the staker to deposit into two pools at the same time. The best pool in the network, and the pool with hook.

The liquidity will idle in the best pool. But soon as a swap happens in the pool with hook, the liquidity will temporarily come back
how_its_made: this project uses chainlink as a oracle to call an API to get the best pool, then put all the idle liquidity into this pool. To move the liquidity uniswap v4 hooks are used to mpve it before swap, after swap and after add liquidity. For the frontend AI was entierly used, as we didn't had a developer
